title: Finley Fox and the Lost Star
description: A magical nighttime adventure of a helpful fox guiding a tiny glowworm back to its family.

scenes.narration: Finley the little red fox was trotting through the silver forest when he saw a bright spark on the grass.
scenes.visual: adorable small red fox exploring a soft misty moonlit forest path

scenes.narration: Oh dear, thought Finley, a tiny star must have fallen right out of the peaceful night sky!
scenes.visual: little fox sitting down looking curiously at a glowing yellow light on a mossy patch

scenes.narration: When he leaned closer, the tiny spark spoke softly. It was not a star, but a lost baby firefly.
scenes.visual: close up of a tiny glowing firefly sitting on a soft green leaf in front of a fox nose

scenes.narration: The little firefly had drifted away from the river meadow and could not find its glowing family.
scenes.visual: small firefly floating sadly in the air while a gentle red fox watches attentively

scenes.narration: Finley lowered his fluffy tail, letting the small insect rest safely on his warm fur as he walked.
scenes.visual: tiny glowing light sitting on the tip of a bushy red fox tail as he walks smoothly

scenes.narration: He guided the little firefly back to the shimmering riverbank, where dozens of bright lights flickered happily.
scenes.visual: cluster of twinkling fireflies surrounding a happy red fox near a peaceful riverbank

scenes.narration: A small kindness lights up the dark. Sleep soundly, and follow along for more bedtime adventures.
scenes.visual: little red fox curled up in a cozy ball sleeping peacefully in a warm den under the stars
